notes: Both coders found one UTSA faculty guide and coded stance delegates. Main disagreements: (1) phase, mostly before-course vs during-work for assignment-design and research-step advice; resolved by whether the act is design/preparation (before-course) or done while working (during-work). (2) policy_type for borderline items (reflection prompt P26 vs P35, bias check P31 vs P53, syllabus privacy tip P50 vs P09, code-of-conduct routing P81 vs P36, grant upload P62 vs P49, supplement-not-substitute P32 vs P56); resolved by what a reader looking for the rule would expect and by the section context, with fit notes kept. 2FA advice stays UNCOVERED. (3) modality should vs must vs informs; resolved by the source wording (imperative with no hedge = must, 'should'/'critical' advice = should, 'you may choose' = may). (4) Coder A split the three syllabus options into three units while B merged them; kept the split (one policy per unit). Only-A units kept: encourage option, not-allowed option, page-10 supplement bullet. Only-B units kept: purpose statement, personalization benefit, faculty-responsible-for-syllabus, academic-integrity-expectations sentence, career knowledge; dropped one (resource list of office names). Alignment was done by source position, with the merged-options unit counted as matched to A's middle option.
